availability.title: My availability
availability.subtitle: Organize your consultation hours and unavailability in a clear weekly calendar.
availability.calendar.title: Weekly calendar
availability.calendar.help: See your availability like a professional agenda. Click an empty time area to prepare a new range, or an existing range to edit it.
availability.calendar.clickToAdd: Click an empty time to add a range
availability.rules.title: My weekly ranges
availability.rules.help: Recurring ranges used to generate your appointment slots. Click a range to edit it.
availability.rules.deactivateMessage: The range will be deactivated: it stays in history but no longer generates slots. The operation fails if appointments exist on this range.
availability.rules.selectDay: Add a range on this day
availability.exceptions.title: Unavailability
availability.exceptions.help: Holidays, training and one-off absences: these periods hide the matching slots.
availability.exceptions.deleteMessage: This unavailability will be permanently deleted. The operation fails if active appointments overlap its range.
availability.slots.title: Slot preview
availability.slots.help: Indicative preview of free slots over the next 7 days (active rules minus unavailability), computed locally. Slot duration (default):
availability.slots.empty: No free slot over the next 7 days.
availability.summary.freeSlots: free slot(s) over the next 7 days
availability.form.requiredFields: Please fill in all required fields.
availability.form.invalidTimeRange: End time must be after start time.
availability.form.invalidValidityRange: End of validity must be after start of validity.
availability.error.AVAILABILITY_OVERLAP: This range overlaps an existing active range.
availability.error.AVAILABILITY_CONFLICT: Appointments exist on this range: action not allowed.
availability.error.AVAILABILITY_NOT_FOUN: Item not found or already deleted.
availability.error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid data: check times and dates.
